PaymentService/Refund.refund_full_amount: TrueLayer open-banking payments land in AUTHENTICATION_PENDING after Authorize; completing bank authentication requires a browser redirect that automated CI cannot drive. No CHARGED payment is available to refund.

PaymentService/Void.void_authorized_payment: The Void suite's fixed dependency is no3ds_manual_capture_credit_card, which uses a Card payment method that TrueLayer does not support. A void can only be tested once a successful manual-capture open-banking authorize is wired up as a connector-specific dependency.
